title: Casa De Monte
shortDescription: Pool villas with classic European elegance set among greenery in Ko Kaeo.
description:
Villa community in Ko Kaeo with a greenery theme and classic European elegance. Facilities include a clubhouse and children's play park, with a gated entrance.
Five house types are offered: Aurellia (A2), Sylvia (S), Silvora (S2), Montara (M) and Lavera (L). Aurellia has a land plot of about 280-584 sqm.
Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.
